rows.title: Association Between State Kratom Policy Status and Kratom‑Involved Overdose Deaths in the United States, 2020-2024: Analysis of the State Unintentional Drug Overdose Reporting System (SUDORS).
rows.focus: Retrospective ecological SUDORS analysis across 45 jurisdictions found kratom detection in fatal overdoses was more common in regulated and no-statewide-policy settings than in Schedule I controlled-substance states; policy context may influence availability and detection, but ecological associations do not establish causality.

rows.title: Unlabeled kratom alkaloids detected in products marketed as kava.
rows.focus: Laboratory analysis of retail products marketed as kava detected kratom alkaloids and semisynthetic derivatives, including mitragynine pseudoindoxyl, providing a plausible explanation for opioid-like withdrawal reports and highlighting mislabeling and surveillance concerns.
